_doc: Session-maintained facts for the repo-health dashboard. generate.py computes every tree-derivable metric itself; this file carries only (a) judgment verdicts a script can't make and (b) live GitHub state only the MCP tools can fetch. Refresh CI lanes + open PRs from the GitHub Actions/PR APIs, re-run generate.py, then republish to the artifact URL below. See README.md.

updated._doc: Per-section last-refresh dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Stamp the matching key on every refresh of that section; generate.py renders the OLDEST as the header freshness badge (green ≤7d, amber ≤30d, red beyond) and repo-health-facts-nudge.sh nags at SessionStart when facts.json itself goes stale.
